$comment: Frontend only. The Nest backend runs on Fly.io (see fly.toml and
docs/ops/DEPLOY_VERCEL_FLY.md). This used to declare a second service with
"runtime": "container", which made Vercel build and run the backend too —
fine functionally, but it pays Vercel container build minutes and keeps the
backend inside the frontend's deployment unit.
CUTOVER ORDER MATTERS: deploy Fly FIRST and confirm https://<fly-host>/health
returns JSON. Only then deploy this config. Setting API_URL to a Fly origin
that does not exist yet takes the whole site down, because every
/api/proxy/* request and every SSR fetch would fail.
The backend origin is API_URL, resolved in src/lib/server-api-url.ts by the
BFF and by the /uploads/* rewrite below. It is deliberately NOT inlined into
the bundle, so switching backends is one env change and one redeploy — no
code change, no rebuild of anything else.

rewrites.$comment: Same-origin path to the Socket.IO transport so the browser needs no API hostname and no cross-site cookie.
OAuth callbacks must be handled by the backend, which owns the state cookie.
